command.sessionId: optional on first input; caller supplies unique id

input.adapters: optional array of adapter records; pass on initial detect/recommend/start

recipes.create: effect recipe; parser URL extracts candidate

effect.resourceId: optional exact owned resource handle for removal

result.durable: true only after actual durable persist
result.notApplied: false/absent on failed create retains uncertainty; true confirms no side effect

durability: persist completion ok:true plus result.durable:true is required before dependent create/remove. persist effect record is a write-ahead intent; host must persist returned state as well.
security: Host admits trusted recipes and validates effects independently. Never supply credentials as literal recipe fields. Raw completion output is transient and never retained. Only credential-free http(s) origins are accepted. IDs are opaque. External-owned records are validate-only. Unknown capability is ineligible when required.

predicateGrammar.paths: JSON pointer ~0/~1 escaping, numeric array indices, * array/object values wildcard; missing/unknown operators fail closed
predicateGrammar.json: bare json pointer extraction never proves detection; add predicate for detection. json-document requires predicate. json extraction parses stdout, or direct result when stdout absent.

urlConstraints.hostnamePattern: optional bounded Rust regex matched against extracted hostname
urlConstraints.rejectMultipleDistinct: always true; zero or multiple distinct matching origins fail

featureGates.legacy: existing non-planVersion1 recipes keep initial conservative gates
featureGates.operational: unknown features, operations, executable fields, binding guards and assertions block entire normalized plan before any effect

host.probe: {nonceRef,verifierRef,expiresAtMs,allowPublicRelay?:boolean}; nonce must be fresh per probe. allowPublicRelay opts into public-relay network path only.

effectMetadata.operation: observe before/after, create/remove execute/persist, probe, health
effectMetadata.recipeRef: create|remove/before|after/stepId or create|remove/execute; remove/ownership intrinsic local-handle inspector; probe and health/expiry intrinsic
effectMetadata.stepId: exact ordered observation id; execute, intent, ownership, probe, expiry reserved by core
effectMetadata.bindings: validated typed binding records; private handle placeholders retained

health.adapterFields: none; all planVersion1 adapters use core generic health/rotation
health.health: advances generation, withdraws old publication, requests fresh exact-origin probe; requires new host.probe nonce
health.update-origin: external-owned only; trusted scoped host.bindings.externalOrigin receipt; advances generation, invalidates all old probes/acks, fresh exact-origin approval required
health.timer: successful probe emits asynchronous timer recipeRef health/expiry; schedule then return candidate-ready, deliver completion when elapsed; failure/expiry withdraws readiness and returns external-owner fix action
health.probeReceipt: nonceRef,verifierRef,origin,vantage,observedAtMs,expiresAtMs,tls,instanceMatched,sse,streamableHttp,oauthDcr; remote:true remains valid for nonlocal. Public-only alternative: remote:false,networkPath:public-relay,publicDns:true,resolvedIp:public-unicast IP, with trusted request host.probe.allowPublicRelay:true. Exact identity/protocol/time checks remain required.
health.expiryOnEveryInput: The core revokes an expired accepted proof before processing any next command, including approve-origin; callers must advance trusted host.nowMs.

operationalPlan.cleanup: always original resource ledger.bindings; host-derived saved binding values and authority still current/fresh; source-derived node/port not reselected. Route guard requires fresh retained ownership receipt and exact live record. Local handles get intrinsic inspect before durable remove.
operationalPlan.jsonNumbers: Persisted deadlines use exact JSON-safe integers; no u64::MAX sentinel crosses the JS boundary.

publicRelay.authority: Trusted host.probe.allowPublicRelay:true is captured in the emitted probe challenge; a completion cannot opt itself in.

receipt.resolvedIp: actual pinned public DNS-resolved public-unicast address

publicRelay.unchanged: All nonce, verifier, exact origin, time, TLS, instance and requested protocol checks still apply. Tailnet/LAN require existing remote:true proof; this alternative never satisfies them.
publicRelay.addressPolicy: Conservative public unicast only. Reject loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT100.64/10, documentation, benchmark, multicast/reserved, IPv4-mapped and special IPv6 transition ranges. No DNS or socket IO occurs in core.
